content:
Hi everyone,

Currently we have datasets being in publishing state (finalizePublication locked) for several days. I have read the troubleshooting guide and wonder if we can remove the lock without restarting server, or if it is suggested to restart server before removing lock.
@Julian Gautier probably knows for sure but for Harvard Dataverse I believe we remove locks all the time without restarting anything.

Yeah I used to remove locks from datasets in Harvard Dataverse using an API endpoint and with nothing being restarted:+1:

I don't check for long lasting locks nowadays but @Sonia Barbosa sometimes reports them and she or another colleagues unlocks them, I imagine using the same API endpoint
Thanks Philip and Julian, I was thinking if it is fine without restarting. :+1:
